name: MacronCoach Third-Party Advisor API
description:
API for third-party advisor systems to access client information and money personality data.

## Authentication
All endpoints require JWT Bearer token authentication. To access the API:
1. Register your client application using the `/api/clients` endpoint
2. Obtain an access token using the `/token` endpoint with your client credentials
3. Include the token in the Authorization header: `Bearer {your_token}`

## Rate Limiting
API requests are rate-limited per IP address. See IpRateLimiting configuration for specific limits.
